class.name: FellowEditorTools
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: what the editor knows about a node that scripts cannot otherwise ask.
class.description: Static methods, in editor builds only (the editor and anything run with an editor build, such as [code]tools/fellow_agent[/code]'s [code]check[/code], which reports every node's configuration warnings with it). See [code]docs/decisions/0153-editor-idle-and-warnings.md[/code].

method.name: get_configuration_warnings
method.description: The node's configuration warnings, the text the Scene dock's warning icon shows: those of its class (stock Godot's nodes' and FellowEngine's) and its script's [method Node._get_configuration_warnings]. Some depend on the node's place in the tree (its parent, the nodes a path leads to): ask once it is in the tree.
